# Create Note

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Creates a note with the given input.

## Syntax

~~~~text
createNote(text: <#String (Allows Variables)#>, show: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
createNote(text: "My new note text!", show: false)
~~~~
